# `eo-coverage`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.40.0, family [Mission analysis, links and space operations](../mission-analysis-links-and-space-operations.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

Earth-observation payload footprint & coverage geometry (SMAD space triangle): Earth angular radius, swath width, nadir ground sample distance, maximum off-nadir access, circular period, J2 nodal period and equatorial ground-track spacing with a contiguous-coverage flag, for an orbit altitude, inclination (sun-synchronous by default) and sensor FOV/IFOV. MODELLED spherical-Earth geometry (no radiometry/MTF/atmosphere/jitter/glint); node spacing R_e·(ω − Ω̇)·T_nodal with first-order J2 secular rates.

One run of `scenarios/eo-coverage.toml` summarises as: eo-coverage: 700 km, ±7.5° FOV -> 184 km swath, 9.8 m nadir GSD, access to 745 km off-nadir; node spacing 2752 km (gapped) (MODELLED)
